intro.heading: ANWESHA
intro.description:
Welcome to Anwesha's corner of the internet!
She's a researcher at Elixpo and a Computer Science and Engineering student at JIS University, working on embedded and heterogeneous systems, efficient machine learning, and computer architecture. She has co-authored four research records, from a 2025 journal paper on a microcoded 8-bit breadboard CPU to 2026 arXiv preprints on Linux-RTOS task recovery and ESP32-S3 video playback. More about her as you scroll down!

fancySection.subtitle: Collabs & Meets!
fancySection.content: The best research is built with others. At Elixpo I co-author papers with Ayushman Bhattacharya, Nihal Gazi, and Vivek Yadav, and each one is published with its code, data, and citation record so anyone can check it. Outside the lab, I lead content for GDG on Campus JIS University and have contributed through GSSoC '25, OSCI '25, and Hacktoberfest. If you're working on systems, efficient ML, or reproducible research, let's talk.
fancySection.contactNote: Reach out if you want to collaborate on a paper, rerun one of our experiments, or just talk about systems and research. Thanks to everyone who has been part of the journey.
